findings.title: RUN_MANIFEST.json / RUNNER_IDENTITY.json written via ungated get_git_sha before the identity gate
findings.body: write_run_manifest and write_runner_identity execute before required_execution_source_identity() in main()'s phase-execution path. A failed identity check still leaves git_sha:"UNKNOWN" on those two files, though RUN_MANIFEST.json's run_status is subsequently overwritten to FAILED/source_identity_unproven. Same nuance the implementer self-disclosed (satisfies invariant 9's 'accepted as authoritative' reading, not a stricter 'before any write' reading); independently rediscovered by the auditor, not new.

findings.title: Preset write_confidence_ramp_artifacts can write CERTIFICATION_RESULT.json before the phase-loop identity gate
findings.body: Reached via --preset before the RTE-W1-010 gate. Lower severity than the closed doctor gap: the auditor verified write_certification_result's payload for this call path does not itself embed a git_sha field (only the doctor-full topology_payload does, and that path is now gated).

findings.title: Audit-prompt wording overstated the implementation's guarantee
findings.body: The audit prompt's checklist item 3 said 'before any canonical evidence write'; the actual guarantee is 'before phase-execution completes and before doctor-persist writes.' A description-precision issue, not an additional code defect beyond R1/R2.

findings.body: At audit time the repo's origin/main tip had moved to 75b4cfc581 from the packet's execution_base 6626aa9a58 due to normal upstream activity during this long session. The RTE branch was correctly created from 6626aa9a58 and is unaffected; expected drift per packet Section 23, not a defect in this packet's work.

findings.title: Some new regression tests are source-order structural guards, not full runtime end-to-end
findings.body: main() is several thousand lines; true e2e simulation offline is impractical. Disclosed limitation, already acknowledged by the implementer.
